description:
Team Myles O'Donoghue are delighted to bring to 51 Whitestown Park to the market. This superb three bedroom semi-detached family home, ideally positioned within the popular residential development of Whitestown Park, Dublin 15.

Presented in good condition throughout, this bright and well-proportioned home comprises; entrance hall, spacious living room to the front and a modern kitchen to the rear. The ground floor benefits from tiled flooring throughout, providing a practical and contemporary finish.

Upstairs there are three bedrooms, comprising two generous double bedrooms and a single bedroom, together with a fully tiled family bathroom. The stairs and landing have recently been fitted with brand new carpets, adding a fresh and modern feel to the upper accommodation. The property also benefits from solar panels, offering an excellent energy-efficient feature for the new owners.

Whitestown Park enjoys a convenient location within Dublin 15, with a wide range of local amenities, shops, cafés and services close by. The area is well served by a selection of schools, parks and recreational facilities, while Blanchardstown Shopping Centre and its extensive range of retail, leisure and dining amenities are within easy reach.

The property also benefits from excellent transport links, with Dublin Bus services providing regular access to Dublin City Centre and surrounding areas. The N3 and M50 motorway networks are also easily accessible, providing convenient connectivity for commuters travelling throughout Dublin and beyond.
